summary: Tested gratuity and processing-fee toggles on manual bookings and quotes, the admin Quotes panel (view/edit/search/filter) and the manual Refund button. Backend: 18 of 19 pytest cases pass. UI: the NewBookingDialog fee/VAT/tip maths, creating bookings, sending manual quotes, refund prompt → dialog → recording a cash/Zelle refund, the unknown-ID message, quote search and filter, and the read-only view of booked quotes all work. Found 1 real pricing bug (editing a manual quote silently drops a processing fee the admin had forced on) and 1 display bug (a literal \u00b7 shows in the edit dialog header).

critical.issue: When a manual quote is created with processing_fee_on=true on a service that has no fee by default (a normal tour), the flag is saved only in payload.processing_fee_on, not on the quote document. _manual_fields does not return it. EditQuoteDialog.pick() reads q.processing_fee_on (undefined → null). The checkbox looks ticked because a Processing line exists, but save sends processing_fee_on:null, and the backend re-prices with the default (off). Repro: create a manual quote 2x$50 with no VAT, fee on and tip 10 = $115. In the UI, change people to 3 without touching the checkbox and save. The quote becomes $160 instead of $167.50. pytest test_edit_untouched_fee_flag_keeps_fee also gets 110 instead of 115.

minor.issue: For tours without child_price (e.g. snorkel-rose), the base is a flat req.price no matter how many people. A 2-person quote shows Fare $75, and editing to 3 people does not change the fare. Same as the existing public booking engine, but it may not be what the admin expects in 'Send as quote'.
Booking.tip_amount allows up to 1000, but ManualBooking allows up to 10000. Editing a catalog quote with gratuity > $1000 will 422.

ui_bugs.issue: A literal '\u00b7' shows ('QUOTE Q-EDE5E9 \U00B7 OPEN') because the JSX text `{q.id} \u00b7 {q.status}` is not a JS string. Use {" \u00b7 "} or a real '·'.
Shows ticked (based on the lines) while the state is null, so the save drops the fee. This is the frontend half of the HIGH backend issue.

issues: The note 'Processing fee and gratuity kept' only shows in the online-refund branch. For cash/Zelle bookings the admin sees 'Up to $100' on a $125 booking with no reason given.

action_items: Fix quote edit losing the forced processing fee: store processing_fee_on (and tip_amount) on the manual quote document in _manual_fields/admin_manual_quote, OR in admin_edit_quote fall back to q['payload'].get('processing_fee_on') when the body value is None. Also make EditQuoteDialog.pick() use q.processing_fee_on ?? q.payload?.processing_fee_on.
Fix the '\u00b7' literal in the EditQuoteDialog header (line 51).
Optional: show the fee/gratuity kept note in the manual-refund section; line up Booking.tip_amount le=1000 with ManualBooking (10000).
critical_code_review_comments: quotes.py admin_edit_quote: fee_on = ch.pop('processing_fee_on', q.get('processing_fee_on')). An explicit null from the UI overrides the stored value, and manual quotes never store it at the top level.

admin_booking_refundable: manual_max equals the online remaining for card-paid bookings too, so an admin could record a cash refund and then still refund via Stripe up to the old amount only if refunded_amount is not shared. It is shared (refunded_amount), so this is OK.
dayof_reminders.py is 1018 lines and server.py is 7234 lines. Both are over the 700-line guideline.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all flows work; edit-quote fee drop + header glyph)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ bookings and quotes (example.com emails, no real phones; one catalog quote used the fictional +12025550143). All were deleted by id at the end. Verified 0 TEST_ quotes and 0 TEST_ bookings left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest tests/test_gratuity_fee_quotes_refund.py -n0. test_edit_untouched_fee_flag_keeps_fee should pass after the fix. UI flow verified: login /admin/login → admin-new-booking-btn; admin-manual-refund-btn uses window.prompt (handle the page dialog); admin-quotes-panel edit at admin-quote-edit-{id}. Quote creation emails/SMSes the guest, so use email-only manual quotes.
rca of the issue: Repro: POST /api/admin/quotes/manual with service_type=tour, trip_cost=50, per_person, passengers=2, no_vat=true, processing_fee_on=true, tip 10 → total 115. Then PUT /api/admin/quotes/{id} with processing_fee_on:null (which the UI sends when the checkbox is untouched) → total 110 and the fee line is gone. Root cause: the fee override is kept only in the payload and is not read back by the editor or the edit endpoint.
